facts.content: Start OTC antihistamine: chlorphenamine 4 mg every 6 hours as needed or a daily non-sedating option.

facts.content: Educate on red-flag symptoms: lip/tongue swelling, stridor, dyspnea and instructions to call 999 or go to A&E immediately if they occur.

facts.content: Monitor arm for spreading erythema, heat, or pain and evaluate for possible antibiotics if these develop.
